To: Mary Frank
Cc: Daniel Valenzuela
The revised draft is ready for your read. I worked from your comments and Daniel Valenzuela's kickoff notes, so the copy now matches the direction we set.
Two lines still need a figure from your side to stand up. I marked both in the margin. Once you confirm them, the {{fact:f:E-2017-001.client}} draft is complete for this pass.
Send the two numbers when you have them and I will return a clean version the same day.
